usage: run_corrective_benchmarks.py [-h] --output OUTPUT [--matrix MATRIX]
                                    [--data-directory DATA_DIRECTORY]
                                    [--parallel-cases PARALLEL_CASES]
                                    [--seeds SEEDS SEEDS SEEDS]
                                    [--samples SAMPLES]
                                    [--families {matrix,upf,paired} [{matrix,upf,paired} ...]]
                                    [--replication-datasets {gauss,circles,electricity,airlines} [{gauss,circles,electricity,airlines} ...]]
                                    [--tracking] [--plan-only]

Run a versioned corrective campaign, retaining metrics rather than model
checkpoints. The same Python entry point runs on a workstation, a batch
worker, or another managed executor. Credentials and resource reservations
belong to the caller. Completed units may be reused; an interrupted unit
restarts its evaluation.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT
  --matrix MATRIX
  --data-directory DATA_DIRECTORY
  --parallel-cases PARALLEL_CASES
  --seeds SEEDS SEEDS SEEDS
  --samples SAMPLES
  --families {matrix,upf,paired} [{matrix,upf,paired} ...]
  --replication-datasets {gauss,circles,electricity,airlines} [{gauss,circles,electricity,airlines} ...]
  --tracking
  --plan-only

usage: export_corrective_evidence.py [-h] --state STATE --output OUTPUT
                                     [--no-plots] [--require-complete]
                                     [--historical-insects HISTORICAL_INSECTS]

Export metric-only evidence for a versioned corrective benchmark campaign. The
source directory stays untouched. Raw inputs, models and training snapshots
are never copied. Native reports and prediction ledgers retain the information
needed to audit every reported metric; paired scores are recalculated on
common event IDs with the benchmark's own exact binary Metrics implementation.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --state STATE
  --output OUTPUT
  --no-plots
  --require-complete
  --historical-insects HISTORICAL_INSECTS
                        Read-only Week 10 INSECTS archive or its dados
                        directory for a descriptive table

usage: publish_corrective_execution_times.py [-h] --state STATE --output
                                             OUTPUT [--tracking]

Derive recorded job-body wall times after a complete corrective campaign. This
post-processing step never trains, changes reports or fills legacy timers.
Only --tracking writes a new metric and provenance tags to the 60 matrix
parents.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --state STATE
  --output OUTPUT
  --tracking

scope: Native x86 runtime selftest and CLI packaging only. No AWS job or benchmark was executed with this image.
